This test will check what you have learned in this lesson:
  • Discuss coincidences, strange events or superstitions.
  • Talk about things that happened or have happened.
  • Talk about cause and effect, and hypothetical situations.
  • Talk about things that have happened, or things that have been happening.
  • Talk about my attitudes toward an action.
